title: There is a sound chip but no sound device
why: Without the right driver or firmware the speakers and headphones stay silent.
fix_summary: Install the missing sound firmware and drivers. Needs the internet.
undo: Remove the package with your package manager if needed.
manual: Connect to the internet and run: sudo secure-linux-drivers install

detector: cmd:klog~sof.*(firmware|fw).*(failed|not found|error)|Direct firmware load for intel/sof.*failed
title: The sound chip is missing its firmware file
why: Newer laptops need a small firmware file for the sound chip to work.
fix_summary: Reinstall the hardware firmware (including sound firmware). Needs the internet.
undo: Not needed: it only puts files back.
manual: Reinstall the sound firmware package (alsa-sof-firmware) and restart.

title: Sound is muted
what: The main sound output is muted, so you hear nothing.
why: It is easy to mute by accident with a keyboard key.
fix_summary: Unmute the sound output.
manual: Press the mute key, or click the speaker icon and unmute.

title: The sound volume is at zero
what: The main sound output is turned all the way down.
why: You will hear nothing until the volume is raised.
fix_summary: Raise the sound to a comfortable level (40%).
undo: Change the volume with the volume keys.
manual: Raise the volume with the volume key.

title: The microphone is muted
what: The main microphone is muted, so nobody will hear you in calls.
why: Some laptops have a mic-mute key that is easy to press by accident.
fix_summary: Unmute the microphone.
manual: Press the microphone key (often F4), or unmute it in sound settings.

title: Sound shows only a "dummy" output
what: The sound system sees no real speakers, only a fake output called Dummy Output.
why: The sound service may need a restart, or the sound chip has no driver.
fix_summary: Restart the sound service. Open programs may need to be reopened.
manual: Restart, or run the restart of pipewire and wireplumber.

title: The sound service is not running
what: The program that handles sound for your account is stopped.
why: With it stopped there is no sound and no microphone.
fix_summary: Start the sound service again.
manual: Run: systemctl --user restart pipewire pipewire-pulse wireplumber

title: Sound is going to the wrong place
what: Sound is set to play through {detail}, but speakers or headphones are available.
why: You hear nothing from the speakers because it plays through a screen or an unused output.
fix_summary: Make your speakers or headphones the main sound output.
undo: Choose the old output in sound settings.
manual: Open sound settings and choose the speakers or headphones.

title: Bluetooth headphones are in call-quality mode
what: Your Bluetooth headphones are in phone-call mode, which sounds thin and muffled.
why: Music modes sound much better. Call mode is only needed while using the microphone.
fix_summary: Switch the headphones to the high-quality music mode.
undo: Choose the call mode in sound settings.
manual: In sound settings choose the High Fidelity profile for the headphones.

title: You did not hear the speaker test sound
why: If speakers are silent the cause could be a mute, the wrong output or a faulty speaker.
fix_summary: Nothing to change automatically.
manual: Plug in headphones. If they work, the speakers or a setting are the cause.

title: The microphone recorded almost nothing
why: A silent microphone is usually muted, turned right down, or switched off by a key or privacy switch.
fix_summary: Nothing to change automatically.
manual: In sound settings, pick the right microphone and raise its level. Look for a mic-off key.

title: The NVIDIA driver is installed but not working
what: Your NVIDIA graphics driver is installed, but the driver part was not built for the current system core, so it is not loaded.
why: This happens right after an update. Without it the screen is low quality or black.
fix_summary: Rebuild the NVIDIA driver for the installed system and refresh the start-up files.
undo: Remove the NVIDIA packages with the safe graphics helper.
manual: Run: sudo secure-linux-drivers reinstall, then restart.

title: The graphics card is not being used for 3D
why: Everything is drawn by the processor, so the desktop and video are slow and use more power.
fix_summary: Install the right graphics driver for this computer. Needs the internet.
undo: Remove the package with your package manager if needed.
manual: Run: sudo secure-linux-drivers install, then restart.

title: Games cannot use the graphics card's fast mode (Vulkan)
why: Many modern games need Vulkan to run well.
fix_summary: Install the graphics libraries games need (Vulkan). Needs the internet.
undo: Remove the packages with your package manager.
manual: Run: sudo secure-linux-drivers install

title: Video playback is using extra battery and heat
why: Hardware video decoding lets the graphics chip play video using little power.
fix_summary: Install the video acceleration libraries for this graphics card. Needs the internet.
undo: Remove the packages with your package manager.
manual: Run: sudo secure-linux-drivers install

title: The graphics driver has been reporting trouble
why: The screen may freeze or flicker. Updates usually fix this.
fix_summary: Open the safe graphics helper. It can use basic graphics while you update.
backup_first: Nothing is changed until you choose.
undo: The helper shows how to undo each step.
manual: Install updates and restart. If it keeps freezing, use the safe graphics helper from the repair menu.

title: The screen is very sharp but everything is tiny
what: Your screen has a very high resolution but the size of text is set to 100%.
why: Text and buttons are hard to read.
fix_summary: Nothing is changed automatically; it depends on your eyes.
manual: Open Display settings and set Scale to 150% or 200%.

title: An extra screen is plugged in but not in use
what: A second screen is connected but is switched off in the display settings.
why: It will stay blank until you turn it on.
fix_summary: Nothing is changed automatically.
manual: Open Display settings and enable the second screen.

title: The screen brightness control may not work
why: You may be stuck at a very dim or very bright screen.
fix_summary: Nothing to change automatically.
manual: Update the system; try the brightness keys and the display settings.

title: The touchpad did not start properly
why: The touchpad may not respond or may stop working after sleep.
fix_summary: Nothing to change automatically.
manual: Restart. If it persists, update the system and BIOS. A USB mouse works meanwhile.

title: The keyboard layout differs between screens
what: The layout at the login and disk-password screens ({detail}) differs from the one on your desktop.
why: Your password may not be accepted at the locked screens if you type it in a different layout.
fix_summary: Make the login and disk-password screens use the same layout as your desktop.
undo: Run: localectl set-keymap with the old layout.
manual: Run: localectl status, then localectl set-keymap <layout>.

title: Some keys may be stuck or not recognised
why: A key that sticks types extra letters, and an unknown key does nothing.
fix_summary: Nothing to change automatically.
manual: Clean under the keys with compressed air. Test with an external keyboard.

title: A mouse or keyboard keeps disconnecting
why: A mouse or keyboard that keeps dropping out feels laggy and unreliable.
fix_summary: Nothing to change automatically.
manual: Try another USB port, avoid unpowered hubs, and replace the battery of wireless devices.

title: A printer is plugged in but printing is switched off
what: A printer is connected, but the printing service is not running, so it will not appear.
why: Without the service no program can print.
fix_summary: Start the printing service.
manual: Run: sudo systemctl enable --now cups.socket

title: A printer is plugged in but not set up
what: A USB printer is connected but has not been added to the printers list.
why: It will not show up when you try to print.
fix_summary: Install the printing and scanning software for it, then it can be added automatically. Needs the internet.
undo: Remove the packages with your package manager.
manual: Open Settings > Printers > Add a printer.

title: A scanner is plugged in but cannot be used yet
why: The scanning software is missing or does not know this scanner yet.
fix_summary: Install the scanner drivers (SANE). Needs the internet.
undo: Remove the packages with your package manager.
manual: Run: sudo secure-linux-parts --install

title: The disc drive could not read a disc
why: A dirty disc is the usual cause; a worn drive is the other.
fix_summary: Nothing to change in software.
manual: Clean the disc with a soft cloth and try again. A USB DVD drive is cheap.

title: The camera is plugged in but does not work
why: The camera driver did not start. A privacy shutter or a key can also switch it off.
fix_summary: Nothing to change automatically.
manual: Unplug and plug in the camera, check the camera on/off key, and restart.

title: The fingerprint reader needs attention
why: The reader cannot be used for login until it is set up.
fix_summary: Nothing to change automatically.
manual: Open Settings > Users > Fingerprint to add a finger.

title: The memory card reader is giving errors
why: A worn card, dirty contacts or a loose card cause read errors.
fix_summary: Nothing to change in software.
manual: Re-seat the card, clean the contacts, try another card.

title: A Thunderbolt device is waiting for your approval
what: A Thunderbolt dock or drive is plugged in but not allowed to talk to the computer yet.
why: Thunderbolt can read memory, so you must approve each device. Only approve ones you plugged in.
fix_summary: Approve the device that is waiting and remember it. It will ask you first.
undo: Run: boltctl forget with the device id.
manual: Open Settings > Thunderbolt and approve the device.

detector: health:usb:errors=FAIL,WARN || health:usb:power=FAIL || cmd:klog~Cannot enable\. Maybe the USB cable is bad|device not accepting address|over-current
title: A USB port or cable is having trouble
why: A bad cable, a hub with no power, or a shorted device makes USB devices vanish or fail to start.
fix_summary: Nothing to change in software.
manual: Try another port and cable. Unplug everything, then plug devices in one at a time.
